messages:
jordan: customer ACME (ticket AC-482) reports invalid_tool_args when calling `send_email` tool. they say payload is "valid json" but our parser rejects it.

jordan: repro payload they sent:
```
\u00A0\u00A0{
  'to': 'ops@acme.com',
  "subject": "Monthly report",
  "body": "See attached",
}
```

priya: can you paste raw bytes? looks like leading non-breaking spaces (copied from Word) + single quotes around keys — both break strict parser. common with copy/paste from docs. ticket?

jordan: ticket AC-482. raw bytes snippet: 0xC2 0xA0 0xC2 0xA0 0x7B ... runtime error: "schema validation failed: invalid JSON at byte 3"

nate: two things: (1) our error should call out the offending char, (2) temp guidance to customer. don't auto-convert single quotes — could mask errors. we can strip leading NBSPs safely. quick sanitize:
```
sed -e 's/\\xC2\\xA0/ /g' payload.json | jq .
```

nate: i'll add a small pre-parse trim of leading NBSP prefixes in the SDKs (warn-only) and a clearer error message. filing ENG-927.

jordan: i'll reply with workaround + ask them to re-send using proper JSON quoting. :thumbsup:

emily: marking P2, assign @nate, update KB article "tool args JSON common errors" with examples (NBSP, single quotes, trailing commas).
